# MCP Tool Discovery for PHP

> A PHP library (novalo/mcp-tool-discovery, MIT, PHP 8.1 to 8.5, no dependency) that decides how an MCP server shows its tools to clients. Its compact mode shows three tools - search_tools, run_read_tool, run_write_tool - instead of the whole list, plus an optional run_write_batch that applies one change to a list of items in one call, with a BM25F tool search that takes the request in fields (action, object, description), holds no list of words, assumes no naming convention, can cache its index and can learn from the tools run after a search. The server keeps every access decision through one interface, ToolGate.

- Answers shaped and validated for the MCP revisions 2024-11-05, 2025-03-26, 2025-06-18, 2025-11-25 and 2026-07-28.
- Modes are packs in src/Mode/: Compact (search and runners), Grouped (one read tool and one change tool per declared group) and Gateway (a single tool, use_tools, with an operation of search, describe or run) and Direct (every tool as itself, for small servers and hosts that let users turn the others off) are shipped.
- A hidden tool is never listed, found, described or run; nothing runs without the host's authorize(); a tool counts as a read only with readOnlyHint: true.
- Plain PHP arrays in and out, in the shape of the specification: works with the official PHP SDK, a framework, or a handler written by hand.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/novalo-dev/mcp-tool-discovery/blob/develop/README.md): install, quick start, modes, search, security model
- [Architecture](https://github.com/novalo-dev/mcp-tool-discovery/blob/develop/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): layers, the flow of a call, protocol revisions
- [Hosts](https://github.com/novalo-dev/mcp-tool-discovery/blob/develop/docs/HOSTS.md): wiring a server, with complete servers written by hand over stdio and HTTP, the same HTTP server kept up in one ReactPHP process, the same as a Symfony application and a Laravel one, and four on the official PHP SDK, with tools outside its registry over stdio or HTTP, added to it, or found by their #[McpTool] attribute; and which changes to the tools change a mode's list, for notifications/tools/list_changed and ttlMs
- [Modes](https://github.com/novalo-dev/mcp-tool-discovery/blob/develop/docs/MODES.md): choosing a mode with the bytes each list costs, the mode contract, Compact, Grouped, Gateway and Direct
- [Search](https://github.com/novalo-dev/mcp-tool-discovery/blob/develop/docs/SEARCH.md): the ranking and its measures
- [Contributing](https://github.com/novalo-dev/mcp-tool-discovery/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md): branches, checks, writing a mode
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/novalo-dev/mcp-tool-discovery/blob/develop/ROADMAP.md): the modes, search work and host examples wanted
- [Security](https://github.com/novalo-dev/mcp-tool-discovery/blob/develop/SECURITY.md): reporting a vulnerability
